description: New York payroll figures for 2026: New York State and New York City resident withholding (NYS-50-T-NYS and NYS-50-T-NYC, Method II exact calculation, Method III for top incomes) and unemployment insurance. Yonkers withholding, Paid Family Leave, Disability Benefits and MCTMT rates are still pending.

sources.title: NYS-50-T-NYS, New York State Withholding Tax Tables and Methods
NYS-50-T-NYC, New York City Withholding Tax Tables and Methods
NYS-50, Employer's Guide to Unemployment Insurance, Wage Reporting, and Withholding Tax
sources.pageNote: HTML page; cites name the section.

stateIncomeTaxWithholding.method: Method II exact calculation: net wages = wages - Table A (deduction + exemptions); then (net wages - column 3) x column 4 + column 5 from the period's table for the marital status. When annualized net wages reach the Method III threshold ($1,077,550 single, $2,155,350 married), use Method III: annualized net wages x the Method III rate / pay periods.
stateIncomeTaxWithholding.exemptionsSource: Number of New York State allowances on Form IT-2104 (line 1).

married_single_rate.note: IT-2104 'Married, but withhold at higher single rate': the booklet doesn't state which table applies; confirm (expected: the single table).

tableA_deductionPlusExemptions.note: Index = number of exemptions (0-10). Above 10: Table B deduction (exemptions = 0 column) + exemptions x Table C.

cite.ref: Supplemental wage payment withholding rates (effective January 1, 2026)

stateIncomeTaxWithholding.rounding: Each step's product is rounded to the nearest cent (half up), as in the booklet's worked examples.

noCertificate.rule: If an employee gives a 2020-or-later federal Form W-4 but no Form IT-2104, the employer may use zero allowances.

cite.ref: New York State, New York City, and Yonkers income tax withholding

nycResidentWithholding.method: Method II exact calculation: net wages = wages - Table A (deduction + exemptions for the payroll period and marital status); then (net wages - column 3) x column 4 + column 5 from the period's Table II. Single and married use the same rate tables; they differ only in Table A/B.
nycResidentWithholding.exemptionsSource: Number of New York City allowances on Form IT-2104 (line 2).

tableA_deductionPlusExemptions.note: Index = number of exemptions (0-10). Above 10: Table B deduction + exemptions x Table C.

unemployment.note: The employer's own normal and subsidiary rates come from its annual Department of Labor rate notice (entered in Payroll > Setup). The re-employment service fund (0.075%) is added to them and isn't creditable against FUTA.

rates.note: Rates are in Publication 420, not supplied.

cite.ref: Metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax (MCTMT) for employers

paidFamilyLeave.note: 2026 employee contribution rate and annual cap (paidfamilyleave.ny.gov) not supplied.

disabilityBenefits.note: DBL employee contribution limit not supplied.

workedExamples.discrepancy: The tables give $258.50: $165.00 x 0.0753 = $12.4245, which rounds to $12.42, but the booklet shows $12.43. The other six examples round to the nearest cent, so this is a one-cent error in the booklet; the engine follows the tables.

The tables give $248.12: $58.80 x 0.0707 = $4.157, which rounds to $4.16, but the booklet prints the rate as 0.070 and the result as $4.15. A one-cent error in the booklet; the engine follows the tables.
